answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1952 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the vertex. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the summit queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The pigment index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 407 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
